scenes.title: Would you pay for the next bit?

sentences.en: Two machines promise fair bits. After seeing the past, would you pay one bit for their next output?
sentences.zh: 两台机器都输出公平比特。知道过去后，你还愿为下一次输出支付 1 bit 吗？

sentences.en: Machine A flips a fresh fair coin every time.
sentences.zh: 机器 A 每次重新抛一枚公平硬币。

sentences.en: Machine B flips one fair coin, then copies that first result forever.
sentences.zh: 机器 B 只抛一次公平硬币，之后永远复制第一次的结果。

sentences.en: Here is one possible output from each. Keep the final bit hidden.
sentences.zh: 各看一条可能的输出序列，先藏住最后一个比特。

sentences.en: Predict the next bit for each machine. Which answer is forced by the past?
sentences.zh: 分别猜猜下一比特。哪台机器的答案已经由过去决定？

sentences.en: A can still produce either bit with equal probability.
sentences.zh: A 仍然以相同概率输出 0 或 1。

sentences.en: B must repeat its first bit. The answer is already in the past.
sentences.zh: B 必须重复第一比特。答案已经包含在过去之中。

sentences.en: At any fixed time, both machines have probability one half for zero and for one.
sentences.zh: 在任意固定时刻，两台机器输出 0 和 1 的概率都各为 1/2。

sentences.en: The fair marginal describes fresh runs. Memory describes dependence within each run.
sentences.zh: 公平边缘分布描述多次重新启动的实验；记忆描述每条序列内部的依赖。

sentences.en: Their marginal entropies are both one bit.
sentences.zh: 它们的边缘熵都等于 1 bit。

sentences.en: Yet the past changes how much their next observation can tell us.
sentences.zh: 但知道过去以后，下一次观察能提供的信息量就不同了。

sentences.en: A contributes one fresh bit of conditional entropy at every step.
sentences.zh: A 每一步都增加 1 bit 的条件熵。

sentences.en: B contributes one bit on its first output, and zero bits after that.
sentences.zh: B 第一次输出贡献 1 bit，此后每次贡献 0 bit。

sentences.en: Add these conditional entropies with the chain rule.
sentences.zh: 用链式法则，把这些条件熵相加。

sentences.en: A has n bits of block entropy.
sentences.zh: A 的块熵是 n bit。

sentences.en: B has exactly one bit of block entropy, for every positive block length.
sentences.zh: 对任意正块长，B 的块熵都恰好是 1 bit。

sentences.en: Only two blocks are possible for B: all zeros and all ones, each with probability one half.
sentences.zh: B 只有两种可能的块：全 0 和全 1，概率各为 1/2。

sentences.en: For A, every length-n block has probability two to the negative n.
sentences.zh: A 的每条 n 比特序列，概率都是 2 的 −n 次方。

sentences.en: Negative log probability gives n bits for A, and one bit for B.
sentences.zh: 取概率的负对数，A 得到 n bit，B 得到 1 bit。

sentences.en: Divide by block length. A stays at one bit per symbol; B approaches zero.
sentences.zh: 再除以块长。A 始终为每符号 1 bit，B 则趋于零。

sentences.en: The limit, when it exists, is called the entropy rate.
sentences.zh: 这个极限若存在，就称为熵率。

sentences.en: It measures new information per symbol over a long sequence.
sentences.zh: 它度量长序列中，平均每个符号带来的新信息。

sentences.en: Now a third machine. Its first bit is fair; each later bit flips the preceding bit.
sentences.zh: 再加一台机器。首比特公平随机，此后每一比特都与前一比特相反。

sentences.en: Its output changes every time. Does that guarantee fresh information?
sentences.zh: 它的输出每次都变化。这一定代表新信息吗？

sentences.en: Predict its next bit after the first observation.
sentences.zh: 看到第一比特后，再预测它的下一比特。

sentences.en: The answer is forced again. Only two alternating blocks are possible, each with probability one half.
sentences.zh: 答案再次完全确定。只有两种交替序列，概率各为 1/2。

sentences.en: Its block entropy is one bit and its entropy rate is zero.
sentences.zh: 它的块熵为 1 bit，熵率为零。

sentences.en: A changing signal can be fully predictable.
sentences.zh: 不断变化的信号，也可以完全可预测。

sentences.en: All three machines have a fair marginal at every time.
sentences.zh: 三台机器在每个时刻都有公平的边缘分布。

sentences.en: Only the independent machine adds a new bit of uncertainty at every step.
sentences.zh: 只有独立机器，每一步都增加一个新的不确定比特。

sentences.en: The copied and alternating sequences show two different kinds of dependence.
sentences.zh: 复制序列和交替序列，展示了两种不同的依赖。

sentences.en: The three rules give stationary processes when the initial bit is fair.
sentences.zh: 首比特公平随机时，这三种规则都产生平稳过程。

sentences.en: Stationarity means every finite-block distribution survives a shift of the time origin.
sentences.zh: 平稳性指：平移时间原点后，每种有限块的分布都保持不变。

sentences.en: For the alternating machine, a one-step shift exchanges two equally likely phases.
sentences.zh: 对交替机器，平移一步只是交换两种等可能的相位。

sentences.en: We have not assumed that dependence disappears at long time lags.
sentences.zh: 这里并未假设：相隔足够久以后，依赖关系就会消失。

sentences.en: Next, we prove that stationarity makes the finite-alphabet entropy-rate limit exist.
sentences.zh: 接下来证明：平稳性保证有限字母表过程的熵率极限存在。

scenes.title: Conditional entropy settles to a long-run average

sentences.en: For a stationary finite-alphabet source, must the information cost per symbol settle down?
sentences.zh: 对平稳有限字母表信源，每个符号的信息代价一定会趋于稳定吗？

sentences.en: Define a n as the conditional entropy of X n given all earlier symbols.
sentences.zh: 定义aₙ为给定此前所有符号时Xₙ的条件熵。

sentences.en: For n equal one, a one is simply the marginal entropy.
sentences.zh: 当n等于一时，a₁就是边缘熵。

sentences.en: The chain rule writes block entropy as the sum of these terms.
sentences.zh: 链式法则将块熵写成这些项的和。

sentences.en: H of X one through X n equals the sum from i one to n of a i.
sentences.zh: H(X₁,…,Xₙ)=从i=1到n的aᵢ之和。

sentences.en: Stationarity lets us shift every finite block without changing its law.
sentences.zh: 平稳性允许我们平移任意有限块而不改变其分布。

sentences.en: Compare a n plus one with a n. Which one can be larger?
sentences.zh: 比较 a n 加一和 a n。哪一个可能更大？

sentences.en: The first conditions on X one through X n.
sentences.zh: 前者给定X₁到Xₙ。

sentences.en: Stationarity rewrites a n using the shifted block from X two through X n plus one.
sentences.zh: 平稳性可用从X₂到Xₙ₊₁的平移块改写aₙ。

sentences.en: By stationarity, the second quantity equals H of X n plus one given X two through X n.
sentences.zh: 由平稳性，后者等于H(Xₙ₊₁|X₂,…,Xₙ)。

sentences.en: Adding X one to the conditioning cannot increase conditional entropy.
sentences.zh: 将X₁加入条件不会增加条件熵。

sentences.en: Therefore a n plus one is no greater than a n.
sentences.zh: 因此aₙ₊₁不大于aₙ。

sentences.en: Every conditional entropy is nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 每个条件熵都非负。

sentences.en: So the decreasing sequence a n has a finite limit.
sentences.zh: 所以递减序列aₙ收敛到有限极限。

sentences.en: Call that limit h.
sentences.zh: 将该极限记为h。

sentences.en: The block entropy per symbol is the average of a one through a n.
sentences.zh: 每符号块熵是a₁至aₙ的平均值。

sentences.en: Cesaro averaging says averages of a convergent sequence share its limit.
sentences.zh: Cesàro平均定理说明，收敛序列的平均值趋向同一极限。

sentences.en: For any positive tolerance, all sufficiently late a i values lie near h.
sentences.zh: 对任意正容差，足够靠后的所有aᵢ都接近h。

sentences.en: The finite number of early terms contributes vanishing weight to their average.
sentences.zh: 有限个早期项对平均值的权重趋于零。

sentences.en: The remaining terms stay within that tolerance of h.
sentences.zh: 其余各项始终在该容差范围内接近h。

sentences.en: Hence H of X one through X n divided by n tends to h.
sentences.zh: 因此H(X₁,…,Xₙ)/n趋向h。

sentences.en: This limit is the entropy rate of the stationary process.
sentences.zh: 该极限就是平稳过程的熵率。

sentences.en: It equals the limiting uncertainty of the next symbol given a growing past.
sentences.zh: 它等于给定不断增长的过去时下一符号不确定性的极限。

sentences.en: For any stationary finite-alphabet source, h is no greater than H of X one.
sentences.zh: 对任何平稳有限字母信源，h不超过H(X₁)。

sentences.en: The first term is marginal entropy; later terms account for predictability.
sentences.zh: 首项是边缘熵，后续各项体现可预测性。

sentences.en: Equality holds for an independent stationary source.
sentences.zh: 对独立平稳信源，两者相等。

sentences.en: Dependence can make later conditional entropies smaller.
sentences.zh: 依赖关系可能降低后续条件熵。

sentences.en: Stationarity is essential in the shift comparison.
sentences.zh: 平稳性是平移比较成立的关键。

sentences.en: Without it, the conditional terms may describe different time laws.
sentences.zh: 若不平稳，各条件熵项可能描述不同的时刻分布。

sentences.en: No independence assumption entered this limit proof.
sentences.zh: 这个极限证明没有假设独立性。

sentences.en: The result covers stationary processes with memory.
sentences.zh: 该结果适用于有记忆的平稳过程。

sentences.en: The Markov property will make their conditional terms easier to compute.
sentences.zh: Markov性质将使这些条件熵项更易计算。

sentences.en: Before computing rates, we need precise language for finite chains.
sentences.zh: 在计算熵率前，我们需要准确描述有限状态链。

sentences.en: Next, distinguish recurrent classes, transient states, and period.
sentences.zh: 接下来区分常返类、暂态状态与周期。

scenes.title: Classes describe paths; period describes return times

sentences.en: A finite Markov chain has a finite state set and transition matrix P.
sentences.zh: 有限Markov链具有有限状态集合和转移矩阵P。

sentences.en: An arrow from i to j means P i j is positive.
sentences.zh: 从i到j的箭头表示Pᵢⱼ为正。

sentences.en: State j is reachable from i if some finite path has positive probability.
sentences.zh: 若存在正概率有限路径从i到j，则称j从i可达。

sentences.en: Two states communicate when each is reachable from the other.
sentences.zh: 若两个状态彼此可达，就称它们互通。

sentences.en: Communication partitions states into irreducible classes.
sentences.zh: 互通关系将状态划分为不可约类。

sentences.en: A class is closed when no transition leaves it.
sentences.zh: 若没有转移离开某类，该类就是闭类。

sentences.en: A finite chain eventually enters a closed recurrent class with probability one.
sentences.zh: 有限链以概率一最终进入某个闭常返类。

sentences.en: A transient state can be left with a positive chance of never returning.
sentences.zh: 暂态状态存在正概率离开后永不返回。

sentences.en: A recurrent state returns with probability one.
sentences.zh: 常返状态以概率一返回自身。

sentences.en: Within a finite irreducible class, every state is recurrent.
sentences.zh: 在有限不可约类中，每个状态都常返。

sentences.en: A recurrent class is a communicating class of recurrent states.
sentences.zh: 常返类是由常返状态构成的互通类。

sentences.en: It is closed in a finite chain.
sentences.zh: 有限链中的常返类必为闭类。

sentences.en: A state and a class are different counting units.
sentences.zh: 状态与类是不同的计数单位。

sentences.en: One closed class may contain many recurrent states.
sentences.zh: 一个闭类可以包含多个常返状态。

sentences.en: Now define the period of state i.
sentences.zh: 现在定义状态i的周期。

sentences.en: List every positive number of steps that can return i to itself.
sentences.zh: 列出所有能够从i返回自身的正步数。

sentences.en: The period is the greatest common divisor of those return times.
sentences.zh: 周期是这些返回步数的最大公约数。

sentences.en: All states in one irreducible class share the same period.
sentences.zh: 同一不可约类内所有状态周期相同。

sentences.en: A state is aperiodic when its period is one.
sentences.zh: 周期为一的状态称为非周期状态。

sentences.en: Consider a chain that alternates deterministically between states zero and one.
sentences.zh: 考虑在状态0和1之间确定性交替的链。

sentences.en: It returns to zero after two, four, six, and later even steps.
sentences.zh: 它在2、4、6等后续偶数步返回状态0。

sentences.en: Its return-time greatest common divisor is two.
sentences.zh: 其返回步数的最大公约数为二。

sentences.en: The chain is irreducible but periodic.
sentences.zh: 该链不可约但有周期。

sentences.en: Start this alternating chain at zero. Will its distribution settle down?
sentences.zh: 让这条交替链从零出发。它的分布会稳定下来吗？

sentences.en: It alternates forever. Yet a fair initial distribution stays fixed.
sentences.zh: 它会永远交替。但公平的初始分布会保持不变。

sentences.en: This already separates stationarity from convergence of an initial distribution.
sentences.zh: 这已将平稳性与初始分布的收敛区分开。

sentences.en: Irreducibility alone does not force powers of P to converge.
sentences.zh: 仅有不可约性并不能保证P的幂收敛。

sentences.en: Aperiodicity will be an additional condition for convergence.
sentences.zh: 非周期性将是分布收敛所需的额外条件。

sentences.en: It is not required merely to define a stationary law.
sentences.zh: 但定义平稳分布并不需要非周期性。

sentences.en: A self-loop permits a one-step return and forces period one.
sentences.zh: 自环允许一步返回，因此周期为一。

sentences.en: Next, solve the balance equations and count their extreme solutions.
sentences.zh: 接下来求解平衡方程，并计数其极端解。

scenes.title: Probability flow balances at every state

sentences.en: A probability row vector pi is stationary when pi P equals pi.
sentences.zh: 若概率行向量π满足πP=π，就称其为平稳分布。

sentences.en: Its components are nonnegative and sum to one.
sentences.zh: 它的分量非负且总和为一。

sentences.en: The equation says one transition step preserves the distribution.
sentences.zh: 该方程表示经过一步转移后分布保持不变。

sentences.en: For each state j, incoming stationary flow equals pi j.
sentences.zh: 对每个状态j，流入的平稳概率质量等于πⱼ。

sentences.en: Both transition rows are one half, one half. How many stationary laws does this chain have?
sentences.zh: 两行转移概率都是二分之一、二分之一。这条链有多少个平稳分布？

sentences.en: Write pi as (a, one minus a).
sentences.zh: 将π写成(a,1−a)。

sentences.en: The first coordinate of pi P is one half for every a.
sentences.zh: 无论a取何值，πP第一坐标都是二分之一。

sentences.en: Stationarity therefore forces a to equal one half.
sentences.zh: 平稳条件因此迫使a等于二分之一。

sentences.en: The unique stationary distribution is (one half, one half).
sentences.zh: 唯一平稳分布为(1/2,1/2)。

sentences.en: Both states are recurrent because both communicate in one closed class.
sentences.zh: 两个状态都常返，因为它们属于同一个闭互通类。

sentences.en: Thus two recurrent states do not imply two stationary distributions.
sentences.zh: 因此两个常返状态不意味着有两个平稳分布。

sentences.en: Now consider a finite chain with several closed irreducible classes.
sentences.zh: 现在考虑具有多个闭不可约类的有限链。

sentences.en: Each closed irreducible class has one stationary distribution supported on that class.
sentences.zh: 每个闭不可约类都有一个支撑于该类的平稳分布。

sentences.en: Transient states receive zero mass under every stationary distribution.
sentences.zh: 任何平稳分布都不给暂态状态正质量。

sentences.en: Collect all transient states in a submatrix Q.
sentences.zh: 将所有暂态状态的转移收集为子矩阵Q。

sentences.en: From each transient state, a finite path reaches a closed class with positive probability.
sentences.zh: 从每个暂态状态出发，都存在正概率有限路径到达闭类。

sentences.en: Finiteness gives a common step bound and a positive lower bound on this exit probability.
sentences.zh: 状态有限，因此可选共同步数界和正的离开概率下界。

sentences.en: Repeated blocks of that many steps make the probability of remaining transient tend to zero.
sentences.zh: 反复经历这么多步后，仍留在暂态区域的概率趋于零。

sentences.en: Closed classes send no probability back to transient states.
sentences.zh: 闭类不会将概率送回暂态状态。

sentences.en: Thus a stationary transient row vector would satisfy mu equals mu Q to the n for every n.
sentences.zh: 因此暂态部分的平稳行向量必须对所有n满足μ=μQⁿ。

sentences.en: Taking the limit forces mu to be zero.
sentences.zh: 取极限就迫使μ为零。

sentences.en: Within each occupied closed class, normalize its stationary mass to total one.
sentences.zh: 对每个具有正质量的闭类，将其平稳质量归一到一。

sentences.en: The finite irreducible-chain theorem gives one stationary distribution within that class.
sentences.zh: 有限不可约链定理保证，该类内部只有一个平稳分布。

sentences.en: Its class mass becomes the coefficient in the mixture.
sentences.zh: 该类总质量就是混合中的系数。

sentences.en: Any stationary distribution is a mixture of the class distributions.
sentences.zh: 任意平稳分布都是这些类分布的混合。

sentences.en: The mixture weights are nonnegative and sum to one.
sentences.zh: 混合权重非负且总和为一。

sentences.en: Each choice of class weights gives a stationary distribution.
sentences.zh: 每组类权重都给出一个平稳分布。

sentences.en: The extreme points correspond exactly to individual closed recurrent classes.
sentences.zh: 极端点恰好对应各个闭常返类。

sentences.en: Their number is the number of closed recurrent classes.
sentences.zh: 极端平稳分布的数量等于闭常返类数量。

sentences.en: It is not the number of recurrent states.
sentences.zh: 它不等于常返状态数量。

sentences.en: For a finite irreducible chain, there is one such class.
sentences.zh: 有限不可约链只有一个这样的类。

sentences.en: Therefore its stationary distribution is unique.
sentences.zh: 因此它的平稳分布唯一。

sentences.en: Uniqueness does not imply convergence from every initial distribution.
sentences.zh: 唯一性并不意味着从任意初始分布都会收敛。

sentences.en: The alternating two-state chain is the counterexample already seen.
sentences.zh: 前面看到的两态交替链就是反例。

sentences.en: Its stationary vector is fixed, but P to the n keeps alternating.
sentences.zh: 它的平稳向量不变，但Pⁿ仍持续交替。

sentences.en: For a finite irreducible chain, aperiodicity guarantees convergence from every initial law.
sentences.zh: 有限不可约链再加非周期性，才保证任意初始分布收敛。

sentences.en: This convergence theorem concerns initialization, not existence of stationarity.
sentences.zh: 这个收敛定理讨论初始条件，而非平稳分布是否存在。

sentences.en: A stationary process is defined by shift-invariant finite-block laws.
sentences.zh: 平稳过程由平移不变的有限块分布定义。

sentences.en: Ergodicity is a separate property of shift-invariant events.
sentences.zh: 遍历性是关于平移不变事件的另一性质。

sentences.en: Now take two disjoint closed classes with their own stationary laws pi one and pi two.
sentences.zh: 再考虑两个不相交闭类，其平稳分布分别为π₁和π₂。

sentences.en: A weighted vector lambda pi one plus one minus lambda pi two is stationary.
sentences.zh: 加权向量λπ₁+(1−λ)π₂仍然平稳。

sentences.en: Its mass on each class is exactly the chosen weight.
sentences.zh: 它在每个类上的质量恰好等于相应权重。

sentences.en: Aperiodicity affects long-run convergence but not this convex description.
sentences.zh: 非周期性影响长期收敛，却不影响上述凸组合描述。

sentences.en: The stationary equation is linear together with normalization.
sentences.zh: 平稳方程与归一化条件共同构成线性系统。

sentences.en: Its solutions form a convex set because mixtures preserve both conditions.
sentences.zh: 由于混合仍满足两条件，其解集构成凸集。

sentences.en: Each closed irreducible class contributes one independent extreme solution.
sentences.zh: 每个闭不可约类贡献一个独立极端解。

sentences.en: Next, use stationary flow to compute a Markov source rate.
sentences.zh: 接下来利用平稳流量计算Markov信源熵率。

scenes.chapter: Entropy rate of a Markov source
scenes.title: Weight each transition-row entropy by stationary flow

sentences.en: For a stationary first-order Markov source, the past predicts through the current state.
sentences.zh: 对平稳一阶Markov信源，过去通过当前状态预测未来。

sentences.en: Given state i, the next-symbol distribution is row i of P.
sentences.zh: 给定状态i，下一个符号分布就是P的第i行。

sentences.en: Let H of P i denote that row entropy.
sentences.zh: 用H(Pᵢ)表示该行熵。

sentences.en: The entropy rate is the stationary average of these row entropies.
sentences.zh: 熵率是这些行熵按平稳分布加权的平均值。

sentences.en: Thus h equals the sum over i of pi i times H of P i.
sentences.zh: 因此h=ΣᵢπᵢH(Pᵢ)。

sentences.en: Use transition rows (zero point nine, zero point one) and (zero point three, zero point seven).
Let pi be (a, one minus a).
Balance for state zero says a equals zero point nine a plus zero point three times one minus a.
sentences.zh: 状态0的平衡式为a=0.9a+0.3(1−a)。

sentences.en: Expand the right side to zero point six a plus zero point three.
sentences.zh: 展开右侧得到0.6a+0.3。

sentences.en: Move zero point six a left to obtain zero point four a equals zero point three.
Therefore a equals zero point seven five.
The other stationary probability is zero point two five.
sentences.zh: 另一个平稳概率为0.25。

sentences.en: The stationary distribution is (zero point seven five, zero point two five).
The stationary transition flow from zero to zero is zero point six seven five.
sentences.zh: 从0到0的平稳转移流量为0.675。

sentences.en: The flow from zero to one is zero point zero seven five.
sentences.zh: 从0到1的流量为0.075。

sentences.en: The flow from one to zero is also zero point zero seven five.
sentences.zh: 从1到0的流量也为0.075。

sentences.en: The remaining flow from one to one is zero point one seven five.
sentences.zh: 从1到1的流量为0.175。

sentences.en: Incoming flow to state zero is zero point six seven five plus zero point zero seven five.
sentences.zh: 流入状态0的总量是0.675加0.075。

sentences.en: That sum equals zero point seven five, its stationary mass.
sentences.zh: 该和等于其平稳质量0.75。

sentences.en: The two crossing flows match, as balance requires.
sentences.zh: 两个交叉方向的流量相等，符合平衡要求。

sentences.en: The first row entropy is binary entropy at zero point one.
sentences.zh: 第一行熵为二元熵H_b(0.1)。

sentences.en: Its value is approximately zero point four six nine zero bits.
sentences.zh: 其值约为0.4690比特。

sentences.en: The second row entropy is binary entropy at zero point three.
sentences.zh: 第二行熵为二元熵H_b(0.3)。

sentences.en: Its value is approximately zero point eight eight one three bits.
sentences.zh: 其值约为0.8813比特。

sentences.en: Weight the first row by zero point seven five.
sentences.zh: 将第一行按0.75加权。

sentences.en: Weight the second row by zero point two five. What is the total uncertainty?
sentences.zh: 第二行乘以零点二五。总的不确定性是多少？

sentences.en: The result is approximately zero point five seven two zero six nine four two bits per symbol.
sentences.zh: 结果约为每符号0.57206942比特。

sentences.en: The stationary probability of state one is zero point two five.
sentences.zh: 状态1的平稳概率为0.25。

sentences.en: So the one-symbol marginal is (zero point seven five, zero point two five).
sentences.zh: 所以单符号边缘分布为(0.75,0.25)。

sentences.en: Its entropy is approximately zero point eight one one two seven eight one two bits.
sentences.zh: 其边缘熵约为0.81127812比特。

sentences.en: The rate is smaller because the current state carries information about the next one.
sentences.zh: 熵率较小，因为当前状态携带了下一个状态的信息。

sentences.en: The chain rule gives block entropy H of X one through X n.
sentences.zh: 链式法则给出块熵H(X₁,…,Xₙ)。

sentences.en: The first term is the stationary marginal entropy.
sentences.zh: 第一项是平稳边缘熵。

sentences.en: Every later term equals the same conditional row-entropy average.
sentences.zh: 此后每一项都等于同一个条件行熵加权平均。

sentences.en: Therefore block entropy equals H of pi plus n minus one times h.
sentences.zh: 因此块熵等于H(π)+(n−1)h。

sentences.en: Dividing by n and taking the limit leaves h.
sentences.zh: 除以n再取极限便得到h。

sentences.en: Zero transition probabilities contribute zero entropy by the usual limiting convention.
sentences.zh: 零转移概率按通常极限约定贡献零熵。

sentences.en: This formula requires stationarity for the weights pi.
sentences.zh: 该公式使用π作为权重，因此要求信源平稳。

sentences.en: The Markov assumption reduces the relevant history to one state.
sentences.zh: Markov假设将相关历史压缩为一个状态。

sentences.en: Next, connect entropy rate to typical path probabilities.
sentences.zh: 接下来将熵率连接到典型路径概率。

scenes.title: Stationarity and ergodicity give a pathwise AEP

sentences.en: For an IID source, sequence probability factors into symbol probabilities.
sentences.zh: 对IID信源，序列概率分解为各符号概率之积。

sentences.en: A source with memory generally has no such product factorization.
sentences.zh: 有记忆信源一般没有这种乘积分解。

sentences.en: We therefore invoke the Shannon–McMillan–Breiman theorem.
sentences.zh: 因此我们调用Shannon–McMillan–Breiman定理。

sentences.en: Assume a stationary ergodic process over a finite alphabet.
sentences.zh: 假设过程平稳遍历且字母表有限。

sentences.en: The theorem states that negative log probability of a length-n block, divided by n, converges almost surely.
sentences.zh: 定理断言，长度n块的负对数概率除以n几乎必然收敛。

sentences.en: The limit is the entropy rate h.
sentences.zh: 该极限就是熵率h。

sentences.en: This statement does not use an IID product formula.
sentences.zh: 该结论不依赖IID乘积分解。

sentences.en: The finite alphabet ensures finite block entropies and integrability of the information density.
sentences.zh: 有限字母表保证块熵有限且信息密度可积。

sentences.en: Ergodicity means every shift-invariant event has probability zero or one.
sentences.zh: 遍历性指每个平移不变事件的概率都是零或一。

sentences.en: Ergodicity prevents different invariant components from retaining different long-run information rates.
sentences.zh: 遍历性排除不同不变分量保留不同长期信息率的情况。

sentences.en: A proof outline studies conditional information increments and their time averages.
sentences.zh: 证明思路研究条件信息增量及其时间平均。

sentences.en: Martingale convergence controls the increments as more of the past is revealed.
sentences.zh: 鞅收敛控制随着过去信息增加而变化的增量。

sentences.en: The ergodic theorem then identifies their long-run average.
sentences.zh: 随后遍历定理识别其长期平均。

sentences.en: This is a theorem invocation, not a full measure-theoretic proof here.
sentences.zh: 这里调用该定理，并不展开完整测度论证明。

sentences.en: Almost-sure convergence also implies convergence in probability.
sentences.zh: 几乎必然收敛也蕴含依概率收敛。

sentences.en: Therefore blocks with surprisal per symbol near h carry probability approaching one.
sentences.zh: 因此，每符号自信息接近h的块总概率趋近于一。

sentences.en: The displayed band uses negative n times the whole quantity h plus epsilon, or h minus epsilon, as its exponents.
sentences.zh: 图中概率带的指数是负 n 乘以整个 h 加 epsilon，或 h 减 epsilon。

sentences.en: This is the AEP for stationary ergodic sources.
sentences.zh: 这就是平稳遍历信源的AEP。

sentences.en: It supplies the typical-set ingredients for compression at rates above h.
sentences.zh: 它提供以高于h的速率压缩所需的典型集依据。

sentences.en: Now verify the theorem on a finite positive Markov chain.
sentences.zh: 现在在有限正转移Markov链上验证该定理。

sentences.en: Use the previous positive transition matrix, initialized in its stationary law.
sentences.zh: 采用上一章的正转移矩阵，并以其平稳分布初始化。

sentences.en: Its empirical transition frequency from i to j converges to pi i times P i j.
sentences.zh: 从i到j的经验转移频率收敛到πᵢPᵢⱼ。

sentences.en: The path probability equals the initial-state probability times its transition probabilities.
sentences.zh: 路径概率等于初始状态概率乘以各步转移概率。

sentences.en: Take negative logarithms and divide by n.
sentences.zh: 取负对数并除以n。

sentences.en: The initial-state contribution vanishes because it is one term divided by n.
sentences.zh: 初始状态项只有一项，除以n后趋于零。

sentences.en: Transition counts turn the remaining sum into an empirical average.
sentences.zh: 转移计数将其余求和化为经验平均。

sentences.en: Each transition probability is positive, so its negative logarithm is finite.
sentences.zh: 每个转移概率为正，因此其负对数有限。

sentences.en: The empirical frequencies converge to stationary transition frequencies.
sentences.zh: 经验频率收敛到平稳转移频率。

sentences.en: The limiting average is the weighted row entropy formula.
sentences.zh: 极限平均正是加权行熵公式。

sentences.en: Thus the Markov path surprisal per symbol tends to h.
sentences.zh: 因此Markov路径的每符号自信息趋向h。

sentences.en: Positive transitions guarantee irreducibility and aperiodicity in this example.
sentences.zh: 此例中正转移保证不可约性与非周期性。

sentences.en: But periodicity alone does not invalidate the general stationary ergodic theorem.
sentences.zh: 但周期性本身不会使一般平稳遍历定理失效。

sentences.en: A stationary irreducible periodic chain can still be ergodic under time shift.
sentences.zh: 平稳不可约周期链仍可对时间平移遍历。

sentences.en: Do not confuse this with convergence from every initial distribution.
sentences.zh: 不要将此与任意初始分布收敛混淆。

sentences.en: That convergence for a finite irreducible chain additionally needs aperiodicity.
sentences.zh: 有限不可约链从任意初值收敛还需要非周期性。

sentences.en: Stationarity alone is not ergodicity.
sentences.zh: 仅有平稳性并不意味着遍历性。

sentences.en: For example, choose a fair hidden component once.
sentences.zh: 例如，只抽取一次公平隐藏分量。

sentences.en: In component A, emit independent fair bits forever.
sentences.zh: 在分量A中，永远输出独立公平比特。

sentences.en: In component B, emit zero forever.
sentences.zh: 在分量B中，永远输出零。

sentences.en: The mixture is stationary, and its long-run fraction of ones identifies the chosen component almost surely.
sentences.zh: 混合过程平稳，而且1的长期频率几乎必然能够识别所选分量。

sentences.en: Its entropy rate averages to one half bit. Must a single path have that same rate?
sentences.zh: 它的熵率平均为半比特。单条路径也一定具有这个速率吗？

sentences.en: Yet a realized path has limiting surprisal rate one in A and zero in B.
sentences.zh: 但实现路径在A中的自信息率趋于1，在B中趋于0。

sentences.en: There is no single almost-sure limit equal to the mixture-average rate.
sentences.zh: 不存在几乎必然等于混合平均率的单一极限。

sentences.en: Stationarity alone does not force different paths to share one information rate.
sentences.zh: 仅有平稳性，不能保证不同路径共享同一个信息速率。

sentences.en: In the mixed example, the component label is invariant under time shift.
sentences.zh: 在混合例子中，分量标签在时间平移下保持不变。

sentences.en: That nontrivial invariant event prevents ergodicity.
sentences.zh: 这个非平凡不变事件使过程不遍历。

sentences.en: The entropy-rate average still exists, but pathwise surprisal has component-dependent limits.
sentences.zh: 熵率平均仍存在，但路径自信息极限依赖分量。

sentences.en: Therefore stationarity alone cannot justify one deterministic AEP value almost surely.
sentences.zh: 因此仅凭平稳性，不能推出几乎必然共享一个确定AEP值。

sentences.en: A typical path in A eventually contains a one, so only its IID component contributes to its block probability.
sentences.zh: A中的典型路径最终出现1，因此其块概率仅由IID分量贡献。

sentences.en: Its block probability is one half times two to negative n, giving asymptotic rate one.
sentences.zh: 其块概率为二分之一乘以2^(−n)，渐近自信息率为一。

sentences.en: The all-zero block has probability one half plus one half times two to negative n.
sentences.zh: 全零块概率为二分之一加上二分之一乘以2^(−n)。

sentences.en: Its normalized negative logarithm tends to zero.
sentences.zh: 其归一化负对数趋于零。

sentences.en: The hidden binary label changes block entropy by at most one bit.
sentences.zh: 隐藏二元标签对块熵的影响最多一比特。

sentences.en: Conditioned on that label, average block entropy is n over two, so the entropy rate is one half.
sentences.zh: 给定该标签，平均块熵为n/2，因此熵率为二分之一。

sentences.en: SMB strengthens this averaged statement to pathwise surprisal convergence under ergodicity.
sentences.zh: SMB在遍历条件下将平均熵结论加强为路径自信息收敛。

sentences.en: Return to the stationary ergodic case. Its typical set has most probability and exponential size near two to n h.
sentences.zh: 回到平稳遍历的情形。典型集承载大部分概率，其规模在指数意义下接近二的 n h 次方。

sentences.en: It does not assert identical probability for all finite blocks.
sentences.zh: 它不声称所有有限块概率完全相同。

sentences.en: Their negative log probabilities differ by a tolerance proportional to n.
sentences.zh: 它们的负对数概率可相差与n成比例的容差。

sentences.en: The next episode uses entropy bounds to build prefix codes.
sentences.zh: 下一集将利用熵界构造前缀码。
